info.description: Voice pipeline on Sarvam AI: speech-to-text, CRM context, text generation, and speech synthesis. Every response is a declared JSON schema, so a typed client can be generated directly from this document.
info.title: NovaConnect Telecoms Conversational IVR Engine

post.description: Assigns the caller (a random demo subscriber for the agents that take existing customers; nobody for pre-sales), greets them, and returns the greeting as text and audio. Pass the returned `session_id` and `caller.phone_number` on every following turn.

413.description: Audio upload exceeds the size ceiling.

post.summary: Start a call: the agent speaks first

get.description: The personas this engine will accept. The frontend renders its agent picker from this list, so the UI cannot offer an agent the engine would reject.

schema.title: Response Get Personas Api V1 Calls Personas Get

delete.description: Called by the frontend's End Call action. Idempotent — resetting an unknown or already-cleared session succeeds. Unauthenticated because a caller ending their own call must always work, and a session id is an unguessable UUID.
delete.summary: End a call and clear its memory

get.description: Operator-only: session transcripts contain what callers said. Used by the console to rehydrate a conversation after a reload.

post.description: Accepts EITHER a multipart `audio` file OR a plain-text `text` field; audio takes precedence when both are supplied. Always returns the same JSON shape — reply audio rides in `audio_base64`, and is null when speech synthesis was unavailable (`outcome: degraded_text_only`) rather than failing the call.

413.description: Audio upload exceeds the size ceiling.

patch.description: Single-field, auditable write — e.g. flipping `router_status` to `Online` after a guided reboot, or advancing `payment_status` once a payment clears. Identity fields (name, account id, MSISDN) are not writable here.
